issues.description: Mismatch between the declaration and definition of Bitmap24::resize_buffer: the header declares resize_buffer(long i_width, long i_height) while the implementation defines void Bitmap24::resize_buffer(int i_width, int i_height). This leads to inconsistent function signatures (different parameter types) and will cause name-mangling/linker mismatches in C++ builds, preventing successful linking or producing confusing compiler errors for students.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the declaration and definition use the same parameter types. Prefer changing the header to use int for consistency with the implementation (void resize_buffer(int i_width, int i_height)) or change the implementation to accept long if long is required throughout. Update both template and solution files so the signature matches.
